page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew lexicon entries with Latin glosses, left column then right column. Page number 470 at top left. Running head in Hebrew letters at top of each column. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: תִּתְעַב abominaberis, vel tur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּעַב, in Piel, תִּעֵב.
תִּתְעַטָּף obruetur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. עָטַף.
תִּתְעַלְּמ abscondes te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. עָלַם.
תִּתְעַלָּפְנָה [?] obteget se, תִּתְעַלָּפְנָה animo deficient, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. & 3. pl. f. Rad. עָלַף.
תִּתְעַמֵּר uteris ad quæ-stum, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. R. עָמַר.
תִּתְעַנֶּנּוּ oblectabis te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. à Rad. עָנַג.
תַּתְעֵנוּ errare facies nos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. תַּתְעֵה, aff. Rad. תָּעָה.
תִּתְעָרֵב miscebis te, vel bit, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָרַב.
תִּתְעָרֵ nudabis te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. R. עָרָה.
תִּתְעַרֶּר nudabitur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. gem. duabus primis radicalibus, pro תִּתְעָרָה, Rad. עָרָה.
תִּתְפַּתָּל elucłaberis, 2. Sam. 22. 27. contr. pro תִּתְפַּתָּל, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. פָּתַל.
תִּתְפַּלָּא mirificum te exhibebis, pro תִּתְפַּלָּא, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. פָּלָא.
תִּתְפַּלָּל orabis, vel orabit, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּלַל.
תִּתְפַּעַם consternata erit, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. פָּעַם.
תִּתְפֹּשׂ prehendes, vel det, fut. Piel, & תִּתְפֹּשׂ capieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. Rad. תָּפַשׂ.
וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ & prehendes eum, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. תָּפַשׂ.
תִּתְפַּתָּל elucłaberis, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. R. פָּתַל.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate; the first Hebrew form of the fourth entry (obteget se) is doubtful and marked [?]. Entry "elucłaberis" printed with long-s-like ligature in the scan, transcribed as printed. Catchword תִּתְצֵב at bottom right.
